functional_goal: Add a deterministic bounded mathematical research-state layer that derives the current dependency/obstruction picture from existing append-only workflow records and gives the web model one transparent advisory next action without changing workflow authority or verified .tex publication semantics.

seven_deliveries.name: governance_baseline_frozen_contracts
seven_deliveries.goal: Approve scope, record the synchronized baseline, freeze complexity budgets and protocol-3 research contract fixtures, and make the constraints machine-checkable.

seven_deliveries.name: pure_types_and_graph_algorithms
seven_deliveries.goal: Implement pure deterministic research types, dependency graph construction, cycle detection, reachability, frontier and digest with exhaustive unit/property tests.

seven_deliveries.name: normalized_append_only_research_records
seven_deliveries.goal: Normalize existing plans, screenings, branches, failures, replans, retrieval and verifier findings into existing logical channels and run projection in read-only shadow.

seven_deliveries.name: protocol_three_research_contracts
seven_deliveries.goal: Enable structured protocol-3 research fields for new runs while protocol-1/2 behavior and the generic rethlas_step envelope remain compatible.

seven_deliveries.name: bounded_advisory_context
seven_deliveries.goal: Expose a bounded obstruction-centered quotient and one deterministic advisory action without giving advice any authority.

seven_deliveries.name: paired_web_driven_mathematical_evaluation
seven_deliveries.goal: Compare protocol 2 and 3 on a frozen real-use corpus with normal web research, workspace Bash/CAS and independent evaluation of final verified .tex outputs.

seven_deliveries.name: cutover_release_and_final_receipt
seven_deliveries.goal: Make protocol 3 the default only after all engineering and mathematical gates pass, prove rollback on copied state, qualify the release and complete the final receipt.

recording_rules.runtime_records: Server-normalized append-only records contain concise mathematical conclusions, typed methods/obstructions/evidence and server-issued identity/order facts; they never contain raw web conversation transcripts or private reasoning traces.
recording_rules.engineering_receipts: Every delivery records before/after commit, changed files, graph changes, commands, exit codes, evidence hashes, failures, repairs, rollback and pending checks before it is accepted.
recording_rules.failure_policy: Failed attempts and rejected evidence are retained and classified rather than erased.
recording_rules.final_delivery: The only final mathematical artifact remains proof_verified.tex through the existing LaTeX, verifier, permit and finalizer path.

A0.required: Build, format, Clippy, tests, graph/governance validators, MTM-009 contract validator and diff checks.
A0.evidence: The complete Rust workspace passes format, warnings-denied Clippy, all-target tests, MTM-009 contract validation, migration/engineering graph validation and diff hygiene after bounded advisory-context integration.

A1.required: Protocol-1/2 frozen compatibility plus protocol-3 research-contract golden fixtures.
A1.evidence: The 82-checkpoint MTM-006 workflow differential retains zero mismatches and frozen SHA-256 def4f7abd3878638ff84952ce2632480eb427649a83868660087c97790de10b0; protocol-3 structured plans, events, screening, branch/failure/replan records and a complete proof_verified.tex path pass strict unit and end-to-end tests.

A2.required: Read-only deterministic shadow projection before model-facing exposure.
A2.evidence: Protocol-2 history is normalized and projected only through the owner-authorized research_state_shadow diagnostic; repeated and eight-way concurrent projections are byte-identical and leave the complete disposable state tree unchanged.

A3.required: Retry/crash/concurrency, identity, capability, branch/verifier firewall and finalizer non-regression.
A3.evidence: Owner mismatch is denied, forged reference/node data cannot influence the graph, malformed collections fail closed, the bounded view is exposed only to protocol-3 Generator/Repair roles, verifier findings enter only Repair-normalized context, Verifier/Branch/Assembler never receive the view, advice is not a precondition, and all existing capability/verifier/finalizer tests pass.

A4.required: Real web-driven paired mathematical evaluation with normal research/workspace tools and verified .tex outputs.

A5.required: Task-envelope, projection latency, RSS, writes, replay and shutdown non-regression.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first grep pattern used a bare exclusion substring and falsely matched that substring inside an ordinary word in the implementation plan, causing the combined final check to exit 1 after all validators and tests had already passed.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Keep the exclusion requirement but use exact phrase and token-boundary matching, then rerun the complete final consistency command.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The non-interactive command environment did not place cargo on PATH, so the first targeted gate exited 127 before compiling any source.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Used the repository-pinned Rust 1.98.0 toolchain under .toolchain with explicit CARGO_HOME, RUSTUP_HOME and PATH, then reran formatting, Clippy and tests without weakening any gate.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first global dependency interpretation did not explicitly distinguish alternative plan routes and could have encouraged a future normalizer to model all plan goals as conjunctive target dependencies.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Added plan-local terminal-goal inference and independent route solved/blocker/invalid/frontier projections, plus a regression proving that one refuted plan does not invalidate another solved plan.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The standalone governance suite correctly reported MTM-006, MTM-007 and MTM-008 implementation-bound target reports as stale after the new workflow source module was added.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Preserved the historical reports unchanged, ran the full Rust workspace and exact 82-checkpoint workflow differential now, and deferred fresh target/release requalification to the release delivery where it is meaningful.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first legacy shadow normalizer accepted any reference_id written into the generation event channel and attached an unknown-node counterexample to the target, which could have distorted future advice despite the layer being non-authoritative.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Cross-check retrieval IDs against the authoritative reference registry, require a recognized canonical node and a meaningful non-empty witness before refutation, and add forged-ID, unknown-node and empty-witness regressions.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Top-level channels were bounded, but nested plan, screening, branch and retrieval arrays were not all bounded; the original warning collector could also emit one detail beyond its declared maximum when adding the truncation marker.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Added hard limits to every normalized nested array, bounded retrieval evidence independently from novelty counts, reserved one warning slot for the truncation marker, and applied UTF-8-safe location/message truncation with adversarial tests.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.stage: legacy identity and join semantics review
recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Colon-bearing legacy plan/subgoal components could make concatenated node identities ambiguous, unknown direct-screening statuses were classified too strongly as failures, and a branch join selected_branch_id was not resolved back to its plan.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Reject ambiguous legacy identity components, normalize absent or future screening statuses as inconclusive with a warning, resolve selected branches through recognized sealed results, and add focused regression tests.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The initial delivery-4 worktree contained interface drift between the delivery-3 normalizer and the new protocol module, plus duplicate engine-side protocol validators and an early delivery-5 task-context projection; warnings-denied Clippy reported 28 compile/dead-code errors.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Aligned the normalizer interfaces, removed the duplicate engine validators and premature advisory-context path instead of suppressing warnings, and retained one pure protocol validation module.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Serializing a newly added critical flag on every research node changed the frozen protocol-2 canonical graph digest even though the field is a protocol-3 semantic.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Represent declared criticality as an optional protocol-3 field omitted from legacy serialization; the frozen protocol-2 digest returned to sha256:9d72141b73f1bc50d69a954996552ab19e0c4d192eac2f9068adc70fc2f122bf without changing the fixture.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Two protocol-3 methodology overlays both wrote mathematical_research_contract, so the later partial overlay could overwrite the earlier complete write and commit schemas and its field names drifted from the actual parser.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Kept one complete protocol-3 methodology overlay, aligned every public field name and fixed bound with the pure protocol parser, and deleted the duplicate overlay rather than maintaining parallel contract definitions.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: A second public_active_plans_v3 formatter rewrote the already normalized plan projection and dropped canonical node_id/kind facts, preventing the web model from referring to the server-issued mathematical node identity.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Deleted the redundant formatter and use one public_active_plans projection that preserves canonical node identity and dependency facts.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first protocol-3 evaluation switch read MTM_WORKFLOW_PROTOCOL_VERSION directly inside RuntimeToolBackend, bypassing RuntimeSettings as the single configuration root.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Moved fail-closed parsing to RuntimeSettings, pass the validated protocol value through RuntimeApplication composition, and keep RuntimeToolBackend free of direct environment reads.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first copied-state rollback probe registered a fresh OAuth client after restart and correctly received RUN_OWNER_MISMATCH; the second reused the original token on a different port and correctly received OAUTH_UNAUTHORIZED because the token issuer changed.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Model the real rollback boundary: copy the OAuth database with workflow state, restart the accepted prior binary on the same origin, and reuse the original owner token. The prior binary then resumed and advanced the protocol-3 run without weakening OAuth ownership or issuer checks.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first direct execution of the persistent rollback harness could not import the scripts package because Python placed only the script directory on sys.path.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Add the repository root to sys.path before importing existing harness modules, matching the established standalone-validator pattern, and rerun the same rollback test successfully.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The initial advisory and compact-view tests used unwrap/expect helpers even though the workspace denies those patterns for all targets; warnings-denied Clippy rejected the test code rather than exempting it.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Convert every new test helper and test body to Result/Question-mark propagation, remove the unused production import, and rerun formatting, Clippy and all-target tests without lint allowances.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.stage: delivery-three verifier-report shape discovered by repair context
recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Repair-context integration showed that the legacy research normalizer recognized only flattened critical_errors/gaps records, while the authoritative verifier actually stores a nested verification_report object plus top-level repair_hints; real verifier findings therefore did not enter Repair research state.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Normalize both the authoritative nested report shape and the historical flattened compatibility shape, add a regression covering both in one replay, expose only the concise repair summary to Repair, and verify the findings disappear again when the workflow returns to Generator.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first full Delivery-5 gate failed only because the MTM-009 validator still enforced the Delivery-3 invariant that mathematical_research_state must never enter task context.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Advance the machine invariant to the accepted Delivery-5 boundary: require protocol-3 Generator/Repair-only exposure through ResearchTaskView and continue rejecting exposure to Verifier/Branch/Assembler roles.
